ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act No. 11 of 2019, as amended; International Companies (Amendment) Act 2021; Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 62]; regulations and directives issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national ID of each shareholder, director, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport office / civil registry authority in the applicant's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the applicant's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter from a licensed financial institution
Professional referral letter (lawyer, accountant, or notary public) confirming applicant identity and business standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commissioner for Oaths / Notary Public / licensed professional in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners against the consolidated UN Security Council sanctions lists, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, HM Treasury consolidated financial sanctions list, EU consolidated sanctions list, and the VFSC domestic PEP and adverse media database; enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs; results must be documented and retained for at least 5 years after the business relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry Online Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be submitted in English or French using Latin characters; any name containing foreign characters must be transliterated into Latin script; the name must indicate limited liability, typically ending in 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or 'S.A.'; the name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered name in the VFSC registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may submit a written administrative appeal to the VFSC Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, detailing grounds for distinctiveness and submitting evidence of any required ministerial or sectoral consent; if the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may appeal to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 30 days under the International Companies Act administrative review procedures.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for marine cargo surveyor services provided that a registered office at a physical street address in Vanuatu is maintained through a licensed registered agent; no physical domestic office or staff is required for this non-financial business, but the registered agent's records must show the company's current business activities and registered agent address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 10% probability of unannounced on-site inspection in normal circumstances); inspection risk may increase if the company is selected for economic substance compliance review under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], ss. 4, 9-10, 14-15, 82-90; Companies Act [Cap. 191] (residual application); Insurance Act [Cap. 231] (licensing nexus)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registrar of International Companies, Companies Registry Division
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form ICS-1) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed; the sole subscriber may subscribe one no-par ordinary share for nominal consideration. Where an escrow is used, subscription proceeds must be held by the registered agent and released only on allotment; no mandatory escrow is imposed by the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — IN WRITING: RESOLVED THAT: 1. The subscription for 10,000 no-par ordinary shares subscribed in the Memorandum is accepted, with subscription proceeds payable to the company's escrow account and allotted upon full receipt. 2. The registered office situated at Port Vila, Vanuatu, as stated in the registered agent's consent, is adopted as the company's statutory registered address. 3. [Name] and [Name] are appointed as founding directors of the company. 4. [Name] is appointed as Corporate Secretary and authorized registered agent representative. 5. The directors and secretary are jointly authorized to execute marine claims surveying agreements, open corporate bank accounts, and complete all VFSC and municipal licensing filings. 6. The common seal, if any, shall be affixed per the Articles. This resolution takes effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — Name Reservation Desk (VFSC Online Registry portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a Name Reservation Application containing two ranked proposed names with a KYC-diligence pack of the intended subscriber, and pay the non-refundable name reservation fee. The Registrar verifies availability against the registered names database and screens for prohibited or undesirable names under s. 15 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On refusal, immediately file a replacement application with a third alternative name; a written appeal with supporting evidence may be lodged with the Registrar within 14 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: KYC and Professional Fitness Screening for Marine Insurance Surveying
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-Authorized Registered Agent (compliance officer) in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver certified KYC files, marine surveying credentials, claims-adjustment certifications, business plan, and criminal-record certificates to the registered agent. The agent screens the file against VFSC AML/CFT Rules and the fitness criteria applicable to marine insurance-related activity under the Insurance Act [Cap. 231] before endorsing incorporation.
required_dossiers: Certified passports of shareholders and directors
Professional marine surveyor certification and CV
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Supplement the file with notarized translations or apostilled documents; where AML queries are raised, the agent may file written representations with the VFSC compliance unit within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-Authorized Registered Agent and Port Vila Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association containing object clauses for vessel hull and cargo damage inspection surveying, the registered agent's consent, and consents of directors. The subscriber and directors execute the instruments before a notary, with specimen signatures attested.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective or incomplete instruments are cured by re-execution before the notary and, where necessary, by filing a corrective statutory declaration with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodging of Incorporation Application and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registrar of International Companies — Companies Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form ICS-1 Application for Incorporation, the executed Memorandum and Articles, registered agent's consent and capital statement with the Registrar. Pay the statutory government incorporation fee of USD 500 by SWIFT wire to the VFSC government account and retain the stamped receipt as provisional filing proof.
required_dossiers: Form ICS-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the file is queried, cure the flagged deficiency within 14 days, pay the administrative correction fee where applicable, and re-submit the amended application to the same file reference.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After statutory verification, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the registered company number and date of incorporation, and releases the corporate kit containing the common seal, blank share certificates, statutory registers and official forms.
required_dossiers: VFSC fee receipt and file reference
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Material errors on the certificate are rectified through a formal rectification application supported by the original certificate and a director's declaration; the Registrar issues a corrected certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-Authorized Registered Agent and VFSC International Companies Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting in writing, adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, allot shares, issue share certificates, and open corporate bank accounts through the agent's banking panel (Underwriter Wire / Wise). Confirm the International Company's tax-exempt status — no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no VAT and no stamp duty on share transfers — for the marine survey consulting income.
required_dossiers: Bank account application and KYC pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Omitting standard governance filings is remedied by filing belated documents with late-payment penalties and, if struck-off, by applying for company restoration under s. 182 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Insurance Division, jointly with Port Vila Municipal Council Business Licence Office
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Marine Claims Survey and Loss Assessment Operating Licence (Insurance Act [Cap. 231] read with the Municipal Business Licence Regulations)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-Risk Registration tier — Environmental Registration Certificate only; full EIA Report is not triggered for an office-based surveying consultancy. Any future shore-based workshop or vessel-station operation would require a Preliminary Environmental Assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Head-office premises must produce zero point-source discharge; no VOC or hazardous wastewater process streams above the DEPC negligible threshold. Shipboard survey work must comply with MARPOL 73/78 Annex I (oil), Annex IV (sewage), Annex V (garbage) and Annex VI (air emissions); waste oils and e-waste must be routed to DEPC-licensed treatment and recycling facilities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service Brigade covering the registered office; structural load inspection certificate per the Port Vila Building Code; Occupational Safety and Health clearance from the Department of Labour (OSH Division) under the Health and Safety at Work Act [Cap. 27]; marine surveyors must hold STCW Basic Safety Training certificates for shipboard inspections.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue Authority (VRA) (successor to the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue); official fiscal portal: https://www.vra.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: International Companies (ICs) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] are statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, and VAT and are not required to obtain a TIN or VAT registration number. The sole fiscal identifier is the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and IC registration number. If an IC anomalously undertakes taxable supplies in Vanuatu, it must submit the VAT registration application (Form VAT-1) to the VRA together with constitutional documents, registered-office certification, and evidence of the Vanuatu supply, with the VRA issuing a VAT registration number within approximately 10 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, hybrid mismatch, or entity-classification election exists under Vanuatu law. An IC that wishes to abandon the exempt offshore zone may apply to the VFSC to convert into an ordinary local company, thereby becoming subject to VAT and local licensing obligations; otherwise the exempt status is automatic and irrevocable while the IC remains in good standing.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 248]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 7,000,000 taxable turnover per 12-month period (mandatory registration); an International Company performing exclusively offshore marine survey services falls entirely outside the Vanuatu VAT net and is not required to register.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu does not operate a real-time fiscal clearance regime, continuous-transaction-control (CTC) network, API-based e-invoicing platform, or digital stamping system. Conventional paper or PDF invoices suffice; the VRA may require production of underlying export contracts, foreign-currency remittance advices, survey assignment logs, and vessel/cargo location evidence during audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Supplies of services rendered to a non-resident recipient (offshore marine underwriter or reinsurer) and performed substantially outside Vanuatu qualify for zero-rating as export services. A marine cargo and hull claims surveyor must substantiate the non-resident status of the insurer, the location of the vessel or cargo, the offshore delivery of the survey report, and the receipt of consideration from abroad. The International Company structure is deemed to operate wholly offshore and therefore invoices without charging VAT rather than claiming refunds; a voluntarily registered local company may zero-rate qualifying surveys and reclaim attributable input VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (required only where surveying involves temporary export of equipment or goods; not required for pure intangible marine survey services)
Bill of Lading (applicable where the engagement includes cargo/equipment movement verification; otherwise replaced by the survey assignment contract and vessel/cargo location certificate)
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT/telegraphic transfer confirmation evidencing foreign-currency payment repatriated from the offshore underwriter
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating claims are presumed to be domestic taxable supplies absent contemporaneous documentation. At audit, the VRA may reassess VAT at 12.5% with statutory interest and late-payment penalties of up to 200% of the tax due, claw back any input VAT credits claimed on survey vessels or testing equipment, and impose criminal sanctions for fraudulent evasion, including substantial fines and terms of imprisonment. For International Companies, the VFSC may additionally suspend or strike off the licence for tax misdeclaration or participation in a Vanuatu-titled supply chain.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — sole central bank and monetary authority administering the Vatu and the national payments system; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) exercises ancillary supervisory oversight over licensed insurance intermediaries but holds no FX regulatory mandate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains an open, fully convertible current account and a liberalized capital account with no statutory impediments to cross-border payments. The Vatu (VUV) is a floating currency managed by the RBV against a trade-weighted basket of major partner currencies (USD, AUD, EUR, GBP, JPY). There are no RBV approvals, quotas, or prior-authorization requirements for trade settlement, foreign direct investment, dividends, or profit repatriation. The only practical friction consists of commercial bank documentation checks (invoices, beneficial ownership declarations, and source-of-funds evidence); tax-exempt International Companies are not required to obtain tax clearance from the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department for remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Nil. Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline for export proceeds. Marine insurance surveying fee receivables may be retained indefinitely in VUV or held in foreign-currency accounts (USD, AUD, EUR, GBP) without RBV consent.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency account (VUV/USD/AUD) with optional segregated capital escrow sub-account
Operational current account (VUV and major foreign currencies)
Operational account with cross-border SWIFT wire capability
Operational account (VUV only; limited international wire services)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as a primary treasury rail. Vanuatu-domiciled International Companies are not supported by most offshore EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Payoneer, Currencycloud) due to the perceived offshore financial center risk profile; none currently issue VUV-denominated local account details, and VUV itself is not a clearing currency on these platforms. An EMI account in AUD/USD/GBP may be used only as a supplementary collection or disbursement channel after substantive domestic bank onboarding is completed, and only where the EMI expressly accepts Pacific island OFC entities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person appearance of all directors is the default mandate at ANZ, BSP, BRED, and NBV for first-time non-resident International Companies. Remote opening is occasionally permitted by ANZ and BSP for low-risk corporate structures via a certified video interview coupled with couriered notarized originals, while NBV requires physical attendance in Port Vila. Introduction by a VFSC-licensed registered agent materially accelerates onboarding and may relax the physical-presence requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee shareholder structure or historical bearer-share architecture of the International Company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified current register of members, VFSC Certificate of Good Standing, signed Beneficial Ownership Declaration identifying the ultimate natural person, written nominee agreement and trustee declaration, and the registered agent's full client due diligence file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt IC status triggering residency and economic-substance questions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Vanuatu registered office lease agreement, evidence of substantive marine surveying operations (professional indemnity insurance, IACS-accredited surveyor credentials, underwriter service contracts), CRS self-certification forms, and a board resolution confirming no tax evasion purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, adverse media, or politically exposed person (PEP) flags on directors or ultimate shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent cleared screening reports (World-Check or Dow Jones), certified passport copies, travel and residence history, professional qualifications in marine hull and cargo surveying, and banker's references from the shareholder's home jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Modest financial footprint typical of a fee-based survey-services start-up
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed underwriter engagement letters, 12-month cash-flow forecast, historical invoicing and payment receipts, corporate CVs and marine insurance survey certifications, and professional indemnity policy schedules evidencing active claim-handling capacity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 credit from the shareholder's personal or corporate bank account to the International Company's commercial bank account in Port Vila. Remittance narrative must state 'Paid-up share capital contribution — Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap. 222]' and reference the shareholder's registered name; the BPM6 purpose category 'Capital account transaction' is used for internal bank classification. No RBV approval is required. The receiving bank conducts full sanctions screening and source-of-funds verification; individual injections above VUV 10,000,000 (approximately USD 85,000) or multiple injections within a 30-day window trigger enhanced due diligence and may require a notarized board resolution and share certificate.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 for all underwriter settlements, reinsurance transactions, legal disbursements, and high-value claims payments, supported by contract and survey report references. Secondary rail: Wise Business or another licensed EMI for minor surveyor fees below USD 2,000 where the counterparty accepts non-SWIFT transfer. Commercial letters of credit and documentary collections are unsuitable for intangibly-delivered survey and advisory services and should be reserved for subcontracted marine equipment purchases backed by transport documents, bills of lading, and inspection certificates.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable VUV/USD forward contracts (tenors up to 12 months) with ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Ltd or BSP Vanuatu, executed back-to-back with an underlying signed marine survey contract
Offshore Vanuatu Vatu non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed via Singapore or Sydney dealing desks for trade-related exposure only, given thin onshore forward liquidity
VUV/USD cross-currency swap under an ISDA 2002 master agreement with a licensed dealer bank for structural mismatches between VUV receivables and foreign-currency liabilities
European-style AUD/USD currency options to cross-hedge AUD-denominated operating costs where the functional currency of the survey ent operations is VUV

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee / IC Renewal Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 20% of the unpaid fee; continued default beyond 12 months may result in administrative strike-off and disqualification of directors.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of Members, Directors, and Registered Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation, jointly with annual fee payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing may trigger a monetary penalty under the International Companies Act and refusal to issue a Certificate of Good Standing until regularized.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Share Transfer Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation within 21 days after anniversary date; any share transfer or UBO change must be filed within 14 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or update beneficial ownership records is a criminal offence punishable by a fine not exceeding VUV 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 12 months.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit applies to a Vanuatu International Company engaged in marine cargo surveying, provided it does not hold a banking, insurance, or public interest license. An audit becomes mandatory only if the entity is designated as a financial institution or voluntarily elects to produce audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) is the recognized standard in Vanuatu; however, an International Company may maintain simplified accounting records sufficient to present a true and fair view in accordance with the International Companies Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must annually confirm the list of ultimate beneficial owners holding 10% or more of shares or control. Any transfer of shares requires immediate updating of the Register of Members and, where ownership changes, an updated UBO declaration must be submitted to VFSC within 14 days.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500–1,500 per annum depending on the registered agent and service level
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit fee applies; voluntary certified audit engagement ranges from USD 2,500–6,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective Vanuatu CIT burden for a licensed International Company. The International Companies Act exempts the IC from all domestic income taxes, stamp duties, and capital gains levies in respect of its offshore business. The only recurring fiscal costs are VFSC annual license fees and registered agent fees; no statutory tax holiday filing is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return exists. Administrative compliance is through the VFSC Annual Return and license renewal filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission using the VFSC e-Services portal (vfsc.vu).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: None for CIT; VFSC Annual Return and annual license renewal required.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: CIT: not applicable. VFSC Annual Return and license fee are due by the anniversary of incorporation each year, subject to the registered agent's internal cut-off and VFSC renewal calendar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No taxable income schedule. The VFSC Annual Return records company name, IC number, registered office, resident agent, registered address, director and shareholder particulars, and a confirmation that the company has not carried on prohibited activities with Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors need not supply any local tax computation. The licensed Vanuatu resident agent submits the Annual Return on their behalf; no non-resident income declaration, foreign account report, or tax identification number is required by the VFSC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No CIT late penalties apply. Untimely submission of the VFSC Annual Return or non-payment of the annual license fee can trigger a late penalty of up to 25% of the applicable fee, suspension of the certificate of incorporation, administrative strike-off, and ultimate deregistration. Knowingly making a false statement to the VFSC is an offence punishable by fine and, for directors and officers, imprisonment under the International Companies Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu imposes no domestic dividend withholding tax. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network; only tax information exchange agreements are in force. A Vanuatu IC seeking foreign treaty relief cannot rely on a Vanuatu DTA. If a foreign jurisdiction requires proof of Vanuatu tax status, the company should obtain a Certificate of Incorporation from VFSC, a current Statement of Good Standing, and, where available, a certificate of tax exemption from the Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury; these are submitted to the foreign revenue authority in support of the applicable foreign treaty claim.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on royalties and interest paid by a Vanuatu IC: 0%. No domestic law imposes WHT on outbound IP royalties or debt interest. There are no applicable Vanuatu treaty reduction rates because Vanuatu does not apply source withholding taxes to these categories.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No threshold applicable in Vanuatu vatu; Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and has not enacted local-file or master-file documentation thresholds. If a Vanuatu IC is challenged by a foreign tax administration, contemporaneous records should still demonstrate arm's-length pricing to avoid recharacterization.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not maintain a domestic Economic Substance Regulations regime for International Companies. An IC must nevertheless maintain continuous substance through a registered office, resident agent, licensed marine surveying activity records, corporate records, and actual decision-making. Foreign tax authorities may apply CFC, controlled-foreign-company, or anti-hybrid rules to attack an IC lacking real economic substance; VFSC licensing and local board oversight are the primary Vanuatu-side substance controls.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu tax-exempt IC as a shell to conceal an operating business physically managed in a high-tax jurisdiction, routing marine survey fees through Vanuatu with no real local activity, or misrepresenting permanent establishment presence outside Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu itself imposes no income tax penalty, but foreign tax authorities may recharacterize profits as deemed taxable income of shareholders or a permanent establishment, impose understated-tax penalties, interest, and back taxes, and apply general anti-avoidance provisions. In Vanuatu, false declarations to the VFSC in support of the tax-exempt status attract fines and cancellation of the IC registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors involved in orchestrating sham arrangements may be subject to foreign joint-and-several liability for corporate taxes, penalties, and interest; they may face personal criminal tax prosecution, travel bans, and imprisonment in the foreign jurisdiction where the economic activity occurred.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC with no boards, no written minutes, no bank-account business rationale, nominee directors signing blank transfers, and no true conduct of marine insurance damage survey work.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vancuatu VFSC may refuse license renewal, strike the company off, or dissolve it under the International Companies Act. The company may also be exposed to foreign compulsory deregistration under shell-company and economic-substance enforcement regimes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and nominee directors may be disqualified, ordered to pay restitution to creditors or government agencies, and subjected to money-laundering charges where the shell structure is used to move illicit premiums or fraudulent claims.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Insurance Surveying and Marine Claims Adjusting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Acting as a marine cargo/vessel hull surveyor or claims adjuster for underwriters without the requisite VFSC business license and applicable financial-services authorization.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Operating without required licensing under Vanuatu financial services and insurance laws attracts monetary penalties, injunctive relief, prohibition orders, and revocation of any affiliated license. Repeat or fraudulent conduct may lead to criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unlawful revenue received, civil fines, and court costs; serious cases involving fraudulent surveys supporting inflated insurance claims can result in custodial sentences and travel-restriction orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting underwriter wire transfers or Wise payments from unknown entities without customer due diligence, failing to maintain transaction records, processing cargo-claim payments linked to false documentation, or conducting transactions with sanctions-listed counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu AML/CFT regime and international bench requirements, licensed entities must conduct CDD, beneficial-ownership verification, and suspicious-transaction reporting; breaches attract substantial fines, licence suspension or revocation, asset restraint, and regulatory winding-up.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who knowingly permit AML breaches may be prosecuted individually, fined, imprisoned, banned from managing companies in Vanuatu, and subjected to personal asset seizure and travel bans pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Filings and Misrepresentation to VFSC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting materially false Annual Returns, misrepresenting shareholding or directorship, disguising prohibited local business activity, or concealing the fact that the IC is used as a conduit for non-shipping investment business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The VFSC may impose fines, revoke the certificate of incorporation, publish the strike-off, and refer the matter to the Public Prosecutor. The International Companies Act treats knowing false submissions as a criminal offense with fine and imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or approve false returns are personally liable for fines, statutory restitution, disqualification as a director, and imprisonment; if the discovered misconduct caused third-party loss, the corporate veil may be pierced for civil damages.
